subject: Deck export glitch before steering call
text: The milestone deck is nearly ready, but the export tool keeps dropping the final three slides when I save it as a file. I suspect a compatibility setting, not a missing asset, because the local preview looks correct. Could you check your access to the workspace and see if the same export happens on the older build? If you confirm the issue, I will switch to the interim format and send the PDF before the steering call. I marked the brief data tables that need your sign-off. No action is needed unless the timeline is truncated.
